incidents.detail: Austin Energy executed a planned 2-hour outage beginning at 3:00 AM June 22 as part of the Waller Beach Duct Bank Upgrade — installation of 1,000 ft of underground power lines connecting the new Rainey Street substation to the downtown grid. Outage was scheduled to restore by ~5:00 AM. Brazos Street excavation continues on weekdays 7 AM–7 PM.

incidents.title: CAPITAL MURDER RAMPAGE — AUSTIN/SAN ANTONIO — SUSPECT IN CUSTODY
incidents.location: Multiple sites, Austin and San Antonio metro area
incidents.relevance: Suspect is in custody — no active threat to property or downtown. AMBER level reflects elevated regional awareness and APD operational tempo from the incident. Staff should remain alert to behavioral anomalies; no specific threat to Four Seasons.
incidents.detail: Shane James, 34, charged with capital murder following a daylong killing spree on approximately June 17–18 spanning Austin and San Antonio. Six people killed, three wounded including two law enforcement officers. An APD officer was shot outside Northeast Early College High School; a cyclist was shot near a trail; four killed at two Austin residences; two killed at a San Antonio-area home. Suspect crashed vehicle during pursuit and was taken into custody. Held in Travis County on capital murder charges.

incidents.title: E. RIVERSIDE AUTZONE HOMICIDE — SUSPECT AT LARGE
incidents.location: 2237 East Riverside Drive, Austin (2.1 mi from property)
incidents.relevance: Incident is 2.1 mi SE of property; no direct threat to downtown or Four Seasons. Valet and door staff should remain aware of suspect description. Elevated concern given suspect remains at large — increased vigilance in surface lot and valet lane.
incidents.detail: Jose Salgado-Amador, 28, shot and killed in the AutoZone parking lot at 2237 E. Riverside Drive on June 15. Suspect: Hispanic male, 15–20 years old, gray hoodie, fled in a light-colored sedan. APD released new surveillance images June 17; no arrest as of June 22 morning. Reward: up to $1,000. Tip line: 512-974-TIPS / Crime Stoppers 512-472-8477.

incidents.title: US–IRAN SWITZERLAND TALKS — ROUND 1 CONCLUDED, 60-DAY ROADMAP AGREED
incidents.relevance: No direct operational threat to Austin or property. Monitor for protest activity near federal buildings (Capitol complex, 0.5 mi NW) if talks become contentious. Guest mix may include diplomatically-connected business travelers given geopolitical activity.
incidents.detail: Round 1 of high-level US–Iran negotiations concluded early June 22 CDT. Mediators Qatar and Pakistan announced both sides agreed to 'a roadmap to achieve a final agreement within 60 days' and will establish a communication line for the Strait of Hormuz. Talks were briefly complicated by Trump social media posts; Iranian delegation remained engaged. VP Vance led US side; Witkoff and Kushner also present. Technical talks now commence. Next round: Washington DC, approximately June 23–25.

civil_unrest.title: No Active Civil Unrest — Downtown Austin
civil_unrest.detail: No protest or demonstration activity reported or anticipated for June 22 in downtown Austin. Juneteenth weekend events concluded. PRIDE festival (June 20) has wrapped. Monitor federal building perimeter (US Courthouse, Capitol) if US–Iran talks generate domestic reaction.
